Name: Expanded Woods
Author: Cylesburk
Description:
This mod expands the woods, opening up an area once cleared by a long gone logging company, exposing a decent number of hardwood stumps to harvest.

To install:
1. Make a backup of the file Woods.xnb located in the steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder.
2. Make a backup of your save file
3. Replace Woods.xnb in your steamapps folder with the .xnb file found in this zip
4. Start game, and enjoy.

Nothing is require to use this mod.

NOTE: This mod is best used on a new game, since it removes the bushes just below the pond in the woods. Unfortunately, despite these bushes being removed, when used with a save game, the bushes remain as they are logged in the save file. Also, when using a save game, sleep for at least one night to allow the additional hardwood stumps to spawn, after that, they will return every day.

NOTE: If additional berry harvesting is what you're looking for in addition to the extra hardwood, please install [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entorox Framework mod[/url] and type "ef_bushreset" without the quotes into SMAPI.

Feel free to endorse if you find this mod useful. Thanks.
